semantically_equivalent_models.justification: LambdaMART is an extension of the MART (Multiple Additive Regression Trees) model, therefore, it is essentially a more specific version within the same family of models.

parent_models.justification: MART is part of the family that includes variants like LambdaMART.

closest_parent_model.justification: LambdaMART is the closest variant under the MART model, being a specialized improvement over MART for ranking, hence it fits as the closest parent.

child_models.justification: Derived directly from MART, LambdaMART is an improved version focusing on ranking tasks.

closest_child_model.justification: As the direct extension of MART, LambdaMART is the most specific child model.

sibling_models.justification: BART and MART both share optimization techniques and trees in their methodologies, with different use cases.

closest_sibling_model.justification: BART is closest functionally and structurally to MART, focusing on regression and classification similar to MART.
